class.name: GodotDoctorCLIValidationCollector
class.brief_description: A [GodotDoctorValidationCollector] for CLI mode. Extends the base collector with support for [GodotDoctorValidationSuite] grouping, aggregating scene and resource results per suite into a [GodotDoctorValidationSuiteValidationCollection].

method.name: on_started_validation_suite_collection
method.description: Called when suite collection begins; creates a new [GodotDoctorValidationSuiteValidationCollection].

method.name: on_started_run_for_validation_suite
method.description: Called when validation starts for [param validation_suite]; tracks it as the current suite.

method.name: on_finished_run_for_validation_suite
method.description: Called when validation finishes for [param _validation_suite]. Adds the accumulated scene and resource collections to the suite collection, then clears the per-suite intermediate collections.

method.name: clear_collections
method.description: Clears all collections, including the suite-level collection.

members.member: The validation suite currently being processed.
The collection aggregating results from all processed suites.
